Name: Owner Squeeze Cascade
Pathway: Revenue decline → Margin compression → Owner compensation cut → Personal savings depletion → Personal credit stress → Consumer deterioration
Mechanism: Owners absorb early stress personally before cutting employees. They cut own pay, use personal savings for business shortfalls, personal credit deteriorates. By the time employment data shows stress, owner households are already in distress. Tariffs 2026 are accelerating margin compression phase.
Feedback_Loops: None — reinforcing: cost squeeze reduces owner income, which reduces consumer spending, which reduces business revenue further
Breakpoint: Owner compensation cuts sustained >2 quarters (BREACHED: 32-50% now cutting)
Consumer_Transmission: DIRECT — owner stress IS consumer stress. $58-116B annual income destruction invisible to employment data
Lag_Time: Immediate (owner comp cuts) to 6 months (personal credit)
Trigger: Revenue decline sustained; tariff cost squeeze
Notes: Upgraded to ACTIVE Apr 2026. Owner comp cuts BREACHED (32-50%). Tariff cost squeeze is the accelerant. $58-116B annual consumer income invisible to headline data.

Name: Employment Transmission Cascade
Pathway: Business stress → Hiring freeze → Hour cuts → Layoffs → Local unemployment spike → Consumer spending decline → Further business stress
Mechanism: Small businesses employ ~47% of private workforce. Employment decisions lag stress by 3-6 months (owners protect workers first, cut own pay). When cuts come, they are concentrated locally. Multiplier: laid-off workers reduce spending, harming neighboring businesses.
Feedback_Loops: Feedback: consumer spending decline worsens business revenue → accelerates stress → more layoffs
Breakpoint: Net employment plans go net negative (currently declining but positive)
Consumer_Transmission: EMPLOYMENT channel — job/income loss. FEEDS CARL's employment/income vectors and LABOR's data
Lag_Time: 3-6 months from business stress to employment action
Trigger: Business stress sustained; hiring plans declining
Notes: Employment expectations at lowest since 2020 (SBCS 2026). Bankruptcy acceleration (+37% Ch.11) confirms business stress present. 3-6 month lag means employment impact expected Q2-Q3 2026. Tariffs accelerating.

Name: Credit Contamination Cascade
Pathway: Business loan delinquency → Personal guarantee called → Owner personal default → Consumer credit deterioration → Reduced consumer credit access
Mechanism: 60-80% of SB loans require personal guarantees. SBA 7(a) requires PG universally. Business default = personal default for owner. Credit score destroyed. Owner household loses mortgage refi access, auto loans, consumer credit. Bankruptcy filing by owner shows on consumer credit. MCA has UCC liens on all business assets.
Feedback_Loops: None — reinforcing: personal default destroys credit access, limiting owner's ability to rescue business or start new one
Consumer_Transmission: CREDIT channel — personal credit destruction. FEEDS CARL's CC DQ, mortgage, consumer credit metrics
Cross_Domain: CARL (consumer credit), PHAN (shadow credit overlap), REGINALD (bank loan quality)
Lag_Time: 6-12 months from business distress to personal default recognition
Trigger: SBA default rate >5% OR Ch.11 acceleration sustained
Notes: SBA defaults at 3.4% (threshold). Ch.11 +37% YoY means restructuring failures will generate PG calls 6-12 months out. MCA stacking is accelerating the timeline for some owners.

Name: Local Multiplier Collapse
Pathway: Small business closures → Lost local wages → Reduced local spending → Neighboring business stress → Accelerated local closure wave
Mechanism: Small businesses buy from other local businesses. Employees spend locally. Closure removes both spending streams simultaneously. Geographic concentration: retail districts, restaurant rows become self-reinforcing closure zones. Chain closures often precipitate independent closures on same block.
Feedback_Loops: Self-reinforcing: closures → lost local spending → more closures. Can create ghost commercial districts.
Breakpoint: Multiple closures in same commercial district (chain closures in 2026 are triggering this)
Consumer_Transmission: LOCAL ECONOMY channel — concentrated geographic impact. FEEDS CARL's regional/geographic stress tracking
Lag_Time: 6-18 months for full local multiplier impact
Trigger: Multiple closures in same geographic area
Notes: Chain closures in 2026 are triggering this in retail districts. Tariffs are applying uniform nationwide pressure — unlike regional shocks, this is geographically broad.

Name: Franchise Failure Wave
Pathway: Franchisor cost pressure → Franchisee margin collapse → Franchisee defaults → Personal guarantee destruction → Franchisee becomes distressed consumer
Mechanism: Franchise agreements require significant personal investment ($200-500K+ buildout). Franchisees personally guarantee buildout loans. Franchisor can tighten royalty terms or mandate upgrades. Tariffs impose uniform cost increases on all franchise locations. Franchisee bears all risk; franchisor absorbs none directly.
Feedback_Loops: None — but chain closure announcements cascade: as parent closes locations, remaining franchisees face less system support, worse brand value, and often accelerated closure requirements
Breakpoint: Major franchise system reports elevated franchisee failures (QSR chains now closing 200-300 each in H1 2026)
Consumer_Transmission: WEALTH DESTRUCTION — total net worth loss for franchisee-owners. FEEDS CARL's wealth/collateral destruction vectors
Cross_Domain: CARL (wealth), REGINALD (bank exposure to franchise debt)
Lag_Time: 12-24 months from franchise system stress to consumer credit deterioration
Trigger: Multiple QSR chains confirming large-scale franchisee closures
Notes: Upgraded from WATCH to ACTIVATING Apr 2026. Wendy's -300, Pizza Hut -250, Papa John's -200 = ~750 QSR locations in H1 alone. Each is a franchisee personal guarantee call.
